name: kitchen_rules
description: A manually defined closed-set kitchen hazard ruleset using YOLO object detections and bounding-box relationships.

rules.name: Person close to knife
rules.description: A person is very close to a detected knife.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with a knife may create a cutting risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip stability, vision or reaction time may increase the likelihood of injury.
rules.recommended_action: Use a stable cutting surface and keep fingers away from the knife blade.

rules.name: Person close to scissors
rules.description: A person is very close to detected scissors.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with scissors may create a cutting or puncture risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced dexterity or slower hand control may increase the risk of injury.
rules.recommended_action: Keep scissors closed when they are not being used and handle them carefully.

rules.name: Knife near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected knife is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The knife may be close to the edge of the working surface and could fall or be knocked off.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A knife near the edge may be difficult to notice and avoid, particularly with reduced peripheral vision.
rules.recommended_action: Move the knife to a stable position away from the counter edge.

rules.name: Scissors near visible boundary
rules.description: Detected scissors are positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The scissors may be close to the edge of the working surface and could fall or be knocked off.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A sharp object near an edge may be harder to notice and may create a puncture or cutting risk.
rules.recommended_action: Place the scissors in a stable location away from the counter edge.

rules.name: Cup near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected cup is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The cup may be close to the edge of the work surface and could be knocked over.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A spilled drink may create a slipping risk or may be difficult to clean quickly.
rules.recommended_action: Move the cup farther from the edge of the work surface.

rules.name: Bottle near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected bottle is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The bottle may be close to the counter edge and could fall, spill or break.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A fallen bottle or spilled liquid may create an obstruction or slipping hazard.
rules.recommended_action: Place the bottle in a stable area away from the counter edge.

rules.name: Bowl near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected bowl is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The bowl may be close to the edge of the work surface and could be knocked over.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Spilled food or a fallen bowl may create clutter, slipping risk or a need for sudden movement.
rules.recommended_action: Move the bowl toward the centre of the working surface.

rules.name: Person close to oven
rules.description: A person is very close to a detected oven.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with an oven may create a burn risk if the appliance or nearby cookware is hot.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced heat sensitivity, balance or reaction speed may increase burn risk.
rules.recommended_action: Maintain a stable posture and use appropriate protection when interacting with the oven.

rules.name: Person close to microwave
rules.description: A person is very close to a detected microwave.
rules.explanation: Removing heated containers from a microwave may create a burn or spill risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength may make hot containers more difficult to handle safely.
rules.recommended_action: Use heat-resistant protection and hold heated containers securely.

rules.name: Sharp object close to cup or bottle
rules.description: A sharp object is positioned very close to a cup or bottle.
rules.explanation: Reaching for the container may result in accidental contact with the nearby sharp object.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced visual awareness or hand coordination may increase the likelihood of accidental contact.
rules.recommended_action: Separate sharp tools from cups, bottles and frequently reached objects.

rules.name: Person close to toaster
rules.description: A person is very close to a detected toaster.
rules.explanation: Close interaction with an operating or recently used toaster may create a contact-burn risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced heat sensitivity, balance or reaction speed may make accidental contact more harmful.
rules.recommended_action: Avoid touching hot toaster surfaces and allow the appliance to cool before moving or cleaning it.

rules.name: Knife close to sink
rules.description: A detected knife is positioned very close to a sink.
rules.explanation: A knife left in or near a sink may be obscured by dishes or water and may cause an accidental cut during washing.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced vision or touch sensitivity may make a partially hidden blade harder to notice.
rules.recommended_action: Wash the knife separately and place it in a clearly visible, stable location.

rules.name: Scissors close to sink
rules.description: Detected scissors are positioned very close to a sink.
rules.explanation: Scissors left among wet dishes may be difficult to see and may create a cutting or puncture risk.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced visual contrast sensitivity or hand control may increase the likelihood of accidental contact.
rules.recommended_action: Remove the scissors from the sink area and store them closed in a visible location.

rules.name: Sharp object close to bowl
rules.description: A sharp object is positioned very close to a detected bowl.
rules.explanation: Reaching for or moving the bowl may cause accidental contact with the nearby sharp object.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced hand coordination or visual awareness may increase the chance of touching the sharp object.
rules.recommended_action: Move knives and scissors away from bowls and other frequently handled containers.

rules.name: Bottle close to hot appliance
rules.description: A detected bottle is positioned close to an oven or toaster.
rules.explanation: A bottle placed near a hot appliance may become hot, melt, leak or contain a flammable cooking liquid.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A heated or leaking bottle may be harder to handle quickly and may increase burn, fire or slipping risk.
rules.recommended_action: Move the bottle away from hot appliances and place it on a cool, stable surface.

rules.name: Cup or bowl close to oven
rules.description: A detected cup or bowl is positioned very close to an oven.
rules.explanation: The container may hold hot contents, become heated or be knocked over while the oven is being used.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength or reaction speed may increase the likelihood and severity of a hot spill.
rules.recommended_action: Place cups and bowls on a stable surface away from the oven opening and hot cookware.

rules.name: Cup or bowl close to microwave
rules.description: A detected cup or bowl is positioned very close to a microwave.
rules.explanation: The container may have been heated and could cause a burn or spill when moved.
rules.older_adult_relevance: Reduced grip strength or heat sensitivity may make a hot container more difficult to handle safely.
rules.recommended_action: Check the container temperature and use heat-resistant protection before lifting it.

rules.name: Fork near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected fork is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The fork may be close to the edge of the working surface and could fall or cause a puncture injury.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A small utensil near an edge may be difficult to notice, particularly with reduced peripheral vision.
rules.recommended_action: Move the fork farther from the edge and place it flat on a stable surface.

rules.name: Toaster near visible boundary
rules.description: A detected toaster is positioned near the visible image boundary.
rules.explanation: The toaster may be close to the edge of the work surface and could be pulled, knocked or fall while hot or connected to power.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A falling hot appliance or trailing power cable may create burn, impact and tripping risks.
rules.recommended_action: Place the toaster on a stable surface away from the counter edge and keep its cable secured.

rules.name: Metal utensil close to microwave
rules.description: A detected metal utensil is positioned immediately next to or overlapping a microwave detection.
rules.explanation: The utensil may have been placed inside or directly beside the microwave, creating a possible arcing or fire risk if the appliance is operated.
rules.older_adult_relevance: A sudden spark, smoke or fire may require a rapid response that can be more difficult with reduced mobility or reaction time.
rules.recommended_action: Do not operate the microwave until all metal utensils have been removed from inside it.
